aPlaceForFriends: A little place for your people
homeIntro: Light the fire, gather your friends, and let a little adventure begin.
bringYourFriends: Pick a little friend. Bring your favorite people.
werewolfRules: Werewolf: Discuss by day and vote. At night, wolves attack, the seer checks a role, and the doctor protects someone. A fallen hunter gets one shot. Villagers win when all wolves are gone; wolves win at parity.
spyfallRules: Spyfall: Everyone except the spy knows the location. Take turns asking one question. An accusation needs more than half the votes. Catch the spy to win. A wrong accusation, correct spy guess, or eight-minute timeout gives the spy victory.
footer: Good stories start around a campfire.
